- `src/main.c` — the compiler: lexer-free recursive-descent parser handling `+ - * /`, parentheses, unary minus, and whitespace; emits NASM-style assembly
- `build.sh` — compiles `src/main.c` with `cc -O2 -Wall -Wextra` into `build/MyCC`
